title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise StoreOnce VSA Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise StoreOnce VSA. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the machineAccountCheck method.
